title: linux-admin 1.18.13 — LVM consolidated into storage
summary: Top-level skill count is now 74. The former lvm-expert has been retired after its PV/VG/LV mapping, filesystem-aware growth, snapshot, thin-pool and rollback guidance was preserved and expanded in storage/chunks/lvm.md. RAID, iSCSI, multipath, NFS, Samba and backup remain separate because their recovery semantics still justify distinct specialists. The latest published GitHub Release remains v1.17.74.
